{{Quote|This is the captain of the freighter ''Suprosa''. Are you crazy? We're hauling fertilizer here! What kind of pirates are you?|Sivar, to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
'''Sivar''' owned the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[MB-C1 medium transport|transport]] ''[[Suprosa]]'' during the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Raid on the Suprosa|raid]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]] that netted the Alliance the [[Death Star II plans|plans]] to the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].
